description: CV sequencer that reads its sequences from a text file, one comma-separated line of voltages per sequence

params.text: Steps back one sequence in the file, wrapping round to the last one
Steps forward one sequence in the file, wrapping round to the first one
Jumps to the first sequence in the file
Attenuates the CV sequence selection, from nothing through to its full range

inputs.text: A rising edge advances one step, wrapping to the start at the end of the sequence; clocks arriving within 1ms of a reset are ignored
A rising edge returns the sequence to its first step
A rising edge steps forward one sequence in the file
A rising edge steps back one sequence in the file
A rising edge jumps to the first sequence in the file
Shifts which sequence plays without changing the chosen one, -5V to 5V covering twenty sequences either way and wrapping round the file

outputs.text: The voltage written at the current step of the sequence
A 10ms 10V trigger fired as the sequence wraps back to its first step

notes: nothing is put out until a text file is loaded with Load File in the right-click menu; each line of the file is one sequence, read as voltages
menu: Load File — opens the text file the sequences are read from; the item under it prints the filename, or No file loaded

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
